name: Blessings of the Gods
description:
Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models. They gain one of the following effects:
– That model’s weapons gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical this activation.
– That model gains one essence, focus, or fury point, or one corpse, rage, or soul token.

name: Bite and Hold
description:
Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models. They gain one of the following effects:
– The Scenario Element that model/unit is currently securing remains secured until the end of the turn unless it is contested by an enemy model.
– For one round while that model/unit is within Scenario Terrain area or 3” of another Scenario Element, it gains Sturdy. (A model with Sturdy cannot be pushed.)

name: Careful Reconnaissance
description:
Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models. They gain one of the following effects:
– That model/unit gains Pathfinder this activation.
– That model gains Reposition [3”] this activation. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3”]'s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3”, then its activation ends.)

name: Duck and Cover!
description:
Play this card any time during the activation of one of your non-Leader warrior models. They gain one of the following effects:
– For one round while that model/unit is within Scenario Terrain area or 3” of another Scenario Element, it gains Dig In. (While dug in, a model gains Cover, Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged.)
– For one round while that model/unit is within Scenario Terrain area or 3” of another Scenario Element, it gains Set Defence. (Models suffer -2 on charge and slam power attack rolls against a model with Set Defence.)

name: Put the Fires Out
description:
Play this card at the start of your Maintenance Phase on one of your models. They gain one of the following effects:
– Shakeable and continuous effects on that model/unit expire.
– Remove d3+1 damage from that model.

name: Heavy Airdrop
description:
Starting on round two, you can play this card any time during the activation of one of your Gravedigger models/units. When you play this card, choose whether to airdrop either a Heavy Weapon Crate or a Squad Class light warjack (Blocker, Raider, or Skirmisher). Add the selected model to your army.

Place the airdropped model 1" away from the model/unit this card was played on.

You can only choose to airdrop a Squad Class light warjack if you played this card on a Gravedigger model/unit with 'Jack Marshal that is not already controlling warjack. The warjack is considered to be controlled by the model/unit this card was played on. An airdropped warjack must forfeit its Normal Movement or Combat Action the turn it enters play.

name: Light Airdrop
description:
Starting on round two, you can play this card any time during the activation of one of your Gravedigger models/units. When you play this card, choose one of the activating models and whether to drop an Ammo Crate, Fuel Canister, Mantlet, or a Medical Crate. Add the selected defense or model to your army.

Place the airdropped model within 1" away from the chosen activating model.

name: Military Engineering
description: Play this card at any time during your turn. When you play this card, you can choose to either immediately remove a Defense from the table or to cause a friendly warrior model to become Dug In. (A model with Dig In gains cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged.)

name: Accursed
description: Play this card on a friendly Grymkin warlock during its activation. While in the Grymkin warlock’s control range, enemy models lose Incorporeal, Tough, and Undead, and cannot have damage removed from them. Additionally, enemy non-warbeast models lose Construct while in the Grymkin warlock’s control range. If your leader is The King of Nothing, while within his control range friendly Grymkin model’s weapons gain Blessed. Accursed lasts for one round.

name: Fortune’s Path
description: Play this card on a friendly Grymkin warlock during its activation. Friendly Grymkin models gain +1 to attack and damage rolls against enemy  models in the Grymkin warlocks control range. If your Leader is The Heretic, increase the bonus to +2. Fortune’s Path lasts for one round.

name: Ill Omens
description: Play this card on a friendly Grymkin warlock during its activation. While in the Grymkin warlock’s control range, enemy models suffer –1 attack and damage rolls agaisnt friendly Faction models. If your Leader is The Dreamer, models in her battlegroup also gain Dodge. Ill Omens lasts for one round. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

name: Labyrinth
description: Play this card on a friendly Grymkin warlock during its activation. Enemy models starting their activation in the Grymkin warlock’s control range suffer –2 SPD that activation. If your Leader is the Wanderer you can also immediately place one model in his battlegroup completely within 3" of its current location.

name: Ruin
description: Play this card on a friendly Grymkin warlock during its activation. Once during the round, when an enemy model casts a spell while in the Grymkin warlock’s control range, you may choose for that spell to not take effect. The spell is still considered to have been cast and its COST remains spent. Additionally, all enemy upkeep spells in the Grymkin warlock’s control range expire. If your leader is The Child she gains 1 fury. Ruin lasts for one round.

name: Sacrifice
description: Play this card on a friendly Grymkin warlock during its activation. Once during the round, when a friendly Grymkin warlock is damaged by an enemy attack. After the attack is resolved, remove all damage from friendly Grymkin models in the warlock's control range. Sacrifice lasts for one round.

name: Shroud
description: Play this card on a friendly Grymkin warlock during its activation. While in the Grymkin warlock’s control range, friendly Grymkin models gain Stealth. Shroud lasts for one round.

name: For the Motherland
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your warrior models/units. Those models gain Tough for one round.
